description: Request a real phone-number purchase. This is APPROVAL-GATED: the carrier bills immediately on execution, so the tool only prepares a request for authenticated owner review. Caller-supplied human_confirmed, dashboard_session, or system_policy fields never authorize execution. Returns the stored request and a review URL for the owner; while approval is pending, no number has been purchased. Existing entitlement and carrier reservation checks still apply. In the acquisition flow this follows set_owner_phone, which saves a reachable owner number or records a decline.

actor.description: Who is asking: { type: agent|human|system|integration, id, display_name }.

agent_id.description: Agent ID to route this number to directly once purchased (optional; requires the number to also be voice-runtime-imported, which is not guaranteed at purchase time — a follow-up attach_number call routes it reliably).

authority.description: Attribution only. human_confirmed and other caller-supplied modes cannot authorize a purchase. Authenticated owner review of the exact stored request is required.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token can access exactly one business).

dry_run.description: Validate tenant, scope, and policy without buying anything.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for the purchase request; repeating it returns the original outcome. Defaults to a key derived from the phone number — a new key retries a previously failed purchase.

phone_number.description: The exact E.164 phone number to purchase, as returned by search_available_numbers.

queue_for_approval.description: Create a durable owner-review request (default true). Setting false returns needs_approval, but an authority-envelope retry still cannot execute.

reason.description: Optional reason recorded in the durable audit.

source_ref.description: External source reference, such as a ticket or automation run ID.

name: buy_number

result.description: On executed: { number, voice_agent_registered, agent_attached, compliance: { high_risk_category, disclosure_note } }.
